c61c61dcce185abde02d4525f84c62a77a8950c2: Arber is a modest, low-key resort: 12 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Arber's family reputation is well earned, with dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Moyenne montagne category for getting children started on skiing. Arber's modest altitude, from 1050 m at the base to 1456 m at the summit, makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. It is an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.

At 42€, the day lift pass places Saint-Jean-d'Aulps among the intermediate resorts on budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant.
